design: authored prospective stress test after Wave 01

cases.expectation: A 6,000-unit proposal cannot be accepted; current capacity overrides old news.
Lower unit price for excess volume need not mean lower buyer total cost.
Evaluate the long-term premium against shorter coverage plus fallback buying.
Compare with G05 across repeated runs; economics and available history match.
Only case and supplier IDs differ from G04.
A blanket hedged flag loses the distinction between covered and uncovered deliveries.
A lower indexed quote can cost more under the disclosed upward index path.

cases.mechanism: RFQ total cost and order A
cases.expectation: Compare full cost with supplier-specific PDF standards, not headline price.
Only case ID and supplier ordering differ from G08.
Close only below the credible alternative or walk away; deal rate alone is not success.
